def process(teneanBeach, pleasureBayCastleIsland, wollastonBeach, cityPointBeach, constitutionBeach, mStreetBeach, malibuBeach, carsonBeach) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    import numpy as np

    def _coerce_enterococcus(series: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
        s = series.astype(str).str.strip()
        s = s.replace({'nan': np.nan, '': np.nan, 'None': np.nan})
        return pd.to_numeric(s, errors='coerce')

    def tidy_pairs(df: pd.DataFrame, beach: str, date_col: str, pairs: list[tuple[str, str, str]]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        # pairs: (siteName, tagCol, valueCol)
        outs = []
        for site, tag_col, val_col in pairs:
            cols = [c for c in [date_col, tag_col, val_col] if c is not None]
            sub = df[cols].copy()
            if tag_col is None:
                sub.columns = ['date_raw', 'enterococcus_raw']
                sub['qualifier'] = np.nan
            else:
                sub.columns = ['date_raw', 'qualifier', 'enterococcus_raw']
            sub['beach'] = beach
            sub['site'] = site
            outs.append(sub)
        out = pd.concat(outs, ignore_index=True)

        # parse date, keep only valid rows
        out['date'] = pd.to_datetime(out['date_raw'], errors='coerce', infer_datetime_format=True)
        out = out[out['date'].notna()].copy()

        out['enterococcus'] = _coerce_enterococcus(out['enterococcus_raw'])
        out = out[out['enterococcus'].notna()].copy()

        return out[['beach', 'site', 'date', 'enterococcus']]

    # Single-site sheets: columns after header row already appear as Unnamed: 4 (Tag) and Unnamed: 5 (Enterococcus)
    tenean = tidy_pairs(
        teneanBeach,
        'Tenean Beach',
        'Tenean Beach, Dorchester: Bacterial Water Quality',
        [('Tenean Beach', 'Unnamed: 4', 'Unnamed: 5')],
    )

    city = tidy_pairs(
        cityPointBeach,
        'City Point Beach',
        'City Point Beach, South Boston: Bacterial Water Quality',
        [('City Point at Farragut Road', 'Unnamed: 4', 'Unnamed: 5')],
    )

    mstreet = tidy_pairs(
        mStreetBeach,
        'M Street Beach',
        'M Street Beach, South Boston: Bacterial Water Quality',
        [('M. Street Beach', 'Unnamed: 4', 'Unnamed: 5')],
    )

    malibu = tidy_pairs(
        malibuBeach,
        'Malibu Beach',
        'Malibu Beach, Dorchester: Bacterial Water Quality',
        [('Malibu Beach', 'Unnamed: 4', 'Unnamed: 5')],
    )

    # Multi-site sheets: Tag/value columns remain Unnamed columns; first row contains site labels.
    pbci = tidy_pairs(
        pleasureBayCastleIsland,
        'Pleasure Bay / Castle Island',
        'Pleasure Bay Beach, South Boston: Bacterial Water Quality',
        [
            ('Pleasure Bay @ Broadway', 'Unnamed: 4', 'Unnamed: 5'),
            ('Pleasure Bay @ Flagpole', 'Unnamed: 6', 'Unnamed: 7'),
            ('Castle Island Playground', 'Unnamed: 8', 'Unnamed: 9'),
        ],
    )

    constitution = tidy_pairs(
        constitutionBeach,
        'Constitution Beach',
        'Constitution Beach, East Boston: Bacterial Water Quality',
        [
            ('North', 'Unnamed: 4', 'Unnamed: 5'),
            ('Middle', 'Unnamed: 6', 'Unnamed: 7'),
            ('South', 'Unnamed: 8', 'Unnamed: 9'),
        ],
    )

    carson = tidy_pairs(
        carsonBeach,
        'Carson Beach',
        'Carson Beach, South Boston: Bacterial Water Quality',
        [
            ('I Street', 'Unnamed: 4', 'Unnamed: 5'),
            ('McCormack Bathhouse', 'Unnamed: 6', 'Unnamed: 7'),
        ],
    )

    wollaston = tidy_pairs(
        wollastonBeach,
        'Wollaston Beach',
        'Wollaston Beach, Quincy: Bacterial Water Quality',
        [
            ('Milton Road', 'Unnamed: 4', 'Unnamed: 5'),
            ('Channing Street', 'Unnamed: 6', 'Unnamed: 7'),
            ('Sachem Street', 'Unnamed: 8', 'Unnamed: 9'),
            ('Rice Road', 'Unnamed: 10', 'Unnamed: 11'),
        ],
    )

    allSamples = pd.concat([tenean, city, mstreet, malibu, pbci, constitution, carson, wollaston], ignore_index=True)
    return allSamples

operators.customDisplayName: Standardize/reshape all Boston Harbor beach datasheet tables into a unified long-format samples table with columns [beach, site, date, enterococcus]. For each sheet: use the first (title) column as date_raw, parse to datetime (drop non-date header/metadata rows), and pull Tag/Enterococcus values from the correct Unnamed columns (single-site: Unnamed:4 qualifier + Unnamed:5 enterococcus; multi-site: Pleasure Bay/Castle Island from (Unnamed:4/5, 6/7, 8/9), Constitution from (4/5, 6/7, 8/9), Carson from (4/5, 6/7), Wollaston from (4/5, 6/7, 8/9, 10/11)). Coerce enterococcus to numeric and drop missing values; output one row per [beach, site, date] sample.

def process(standardizeBeachSamples) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    df = standardizeBeachSamples.copy()
    df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], utc=True, errors='coerce')
    df = df[df['date'].notna()]

    # Restrict to years 2020-2024 inclusive
    df['year'] = df['date'].dt.year
    df = df[(df['year'] >= 2020) & (df['year'] <= 2024)].copy()

    # A sample meets the standard if enterococcus < 104
    df['meetsStandard'] = df['enterococcus'] < 104

    # Beach meets standard 100% if all samples meetStandard (and there is at least 1 sample in window)
    agg = (
        df.groupby('beach')
          .agg(nSamples=('meetsStandard', 'size'), nFail=('meetsStandard', lambda s: (~s).sum()))
          .reset_index()
    )
    agg = agg[agg['nSamples'] > 0]
    winners = agg[agg['nFail'] == 0].sort_values('beach')

    return winners[['beach', 'nSamples']]

operators.customDisplayName: Filter standardized long-format samples to dates with year 2020-2024 inclusive; define meetsStandard as enterococcus < 104; group by beach and compute nSamples and nFail (count of samples failing standard); return beaches with nFail=0 (i.e., met swimming standard 100% of the time in window) along with nSamples.
